overview.label: BRAND OVERVIEW
overview.title: The entire sound journey, designed as a single value chain.
overview.p1: Great music experiences don't end at production. AUDIOGUY precisely captures the essence of sound through recording, mixing, and mastering, and expands it into immersive listening experiences with Sound 360's spatial-sound technology.
overview.p2: And the completed sound is connected to market- and platform-specific distribution through SEORO. AUDIOGUY designs production, spatial audio, and distribution not as separate stages but as a single flow.
overview.p3: We don't stop at making sound.
overview.p4: We design how music sounds, how the experience expands, and which markets it reaches. AUDIOGUY is an audio value-chain group that turns music into more immersive experiences.

tech.title: Verified Technology
tech.subtitle: Spatial Audio AI Engine
tech.name: AI-SPHR
tech.description: AI-SPHR is AUDIOGUY’s proprietary engine that analyzes audio sources, converts them into spatial audio structures, and reviews the output against global platform standards.
tech.card1Desc: Trained a spatial-audio conversion model on 6,000+ high-quality audio datasets.
tech.card2Desc: Analyzes a track’s frequencies, instrument placement, and reverb characteristics to design a three-dimensional sound structure.
tech.card3Desc: Converts the result to meet the standards of global platforms such as Dolby Atmos and Apple Music.

Sound360.label: Dolby Atmos
Sound360.title: MAKE SOUND 360°
Sound360.description:
SOUND360 is Korea's first music studio to adopt the Dolby Atmos system.
Building on AUDIOGUY's 25+ years of capturing sound in the field, we added spatial-audio production spanning music and XR.
We give space to sound and redesign the way music is heard.

Seoro.label: SEORO DISTRIBUTION
Seoro.title: New Roads in Asia
Seoro.desc1: SEORO doesn't simply connect music to existing markets —
Seoro.desc2: it designs new pathways across Asia where music can expand.
Seoro.businessCaption: Connecting spatial-sound production, Asia distribution, and media expansion as a single flow.
Seoro.businessDesc:
SEORO combines Dolby Atmos production, regional Asian distribution strategy, and media expansion
into a single integrated framework.
Seoro.biz2Desc: Designing strategy for Asian DSP markets
Seoro.biz3Desc: Expanding music exposure and reach on DSPs
Seoro.processCaption: From sound to market — a clear path
Seoro.processDesc: SEORO systematically manages everything from intake and production to metadata, DSP delivery, pitching, and reporting.
Seoro.step1Hint: We review the audio, artist info, release goals, and required materials.
Seoro.step1Desc: We take in basic details like release format and schedule, then advise on the right distribution path.
Seoro.step2Desc: We sign the distribution agreement and register the revenue-share structure and settlement details.
Seoro.step3Desc: Submit the audio, cover art, artist info, and other materials needed for release.
Seoro.step4Desc: We support Dolby Atmos and Eclipsa Audio production.
Seoro.step5Desc: We register tracks on major domestic and global platforms and apply the release schedule.
Seoro.step6Desc: We pitch tracks to platform editors to widen playlist exposure.
Seoro.step7Desc: Tracks go live on the release date and can be streamed across platforms.
Seoro.step8Desc: We settle revenue based on streaming data and provide reports.
Seoro.dspDesc: We provide a distribution network connecting Korea, Japan, and global markets. SEORO designs distribution pathways to major DSPs and global platforms based on release goals, rights status, and target market.
Seoro.partnersCaption: Designing Asian market expansion together with production, distribution, and media partners
Seoro.partnersDesc:
SEORO collaborates with partners experienced in spatial-sound production, distribution, media reach, and regional markets
to help music be heard better.
Seoro.settlementDesc: Through SOVO360, SEORO's own settlement system, we transparently manage platform revenue, per-release reports, and overall settlement status.
